emergency.condition_text: you have become the table's problem, and the board that ends a seat is already on the table
indications: The table names you aloud. On 29 October Mirari's Wake drew "that's going to be a problem" the turn it landed, and after the first reveals every seat was dealing with Sean (log:003).
Your total power is greater than one seat's life plus its untapped blockers. On 15 September it was 8 to 9 Dinosaurs and 30-plus power against Alex at 18 and Oliver at 15 (log:002).
You have swung two or three creatures out of a full board, or none, for a turn. Both logged losses went this way (log:002, log:003).
A seat you have named as the danger has not been attacked. On 29 October that was Alex's artifact board and its growing creature, and Alex won (log:003).
A no-attack deal is standing while you hold the biggest board (log:002).
immediate: Count every seat before you declare an attacker: your power, after Overwhelming Stampede, Berserkers' Onslaught or Kessig Wolf Run, against that seat's life plus its untapped blockers. Say each total aloud. Count Gishath's commander damage per seat toward 21.
If two or more seats die this turn, attack every one of them. A seat left alive saves the seat you attacked, and on 15 September that seat won (log:002).
If no seat dies, send everything at the seat whose board beats yours, not at the seat that is easy to hit. On 29 October that was Alex (log:003).
Declare every creature that can attack. Losing Dinosaurs in blocks is the price of the swing; a Dinosaur held home for fear of a block is the loss on 29 October (log:003).
Keep one shield castable after attacks. Flawless Maneuver costs nothing while Gishath is on the battlefield; otherwise leave {1}{G} for Heroic Intervention or {R}{W} for Boros Charm untapped.
subsequent: Main two: cast the Dinosaurs in hand. With Hunting Velociraptor out and a Dinosaur having dealt combat damage this turn, each costs prowl {2}{R}.
Next turn, attack again with everything, including the Dinosaurs the reveal put onto the battlefield. They entered after attackers were declared and could not swing until now.
Do not stop to rebuild between swings while a seat is in range. Keep attacking until the seat whose board beats yours is dead.
emergency.notes: Revealed Dinosaurs enter after attackers are declared, so they attack the turn after the reveal. That following turn is the pivot: the board is at its largest and the table has not yet answered it. Both losses in the log were boards that were ahead on that turn and did not commit (log:002, log:003).

emergency.condition_text: a sweeper is coming, or has landed, and it takes the mana creatures with the Dinosaurs
indications: A seat passes its own turn with four to six mana open and casts nothing in its main phase.
Your board is the largest at the table by three or more creatures.

Your mana stands on creatures: Ixalli's Lorekeeper, Bloom Tender, Drover of the Mighty, Intrepid Paleontologist, Atzocan Seer, Faeburrow Elder, Selvala, Hulking Raptor, Regal Behemoth. A creature sweeper takes all of them.
The pod has already wiped once. On 15 September it was "wipe after wipe" for two and a half hours (log:002).
On 28 August the table spent its wipes on the mid-tier Dinosaurs and had none left when Gishath landed (log:001).
immediate: Stop casting creatures. Every body still in hand waits until the sweeper resolves or that seat taps out.
Read the sweeper's verb. Destroy or damage: Flawless Maneuver (free with Gishath out), Heroic Intervention {1}{G}, Boros Charm {R}{W}, Akroma's Will {3}{W}. Cast the cheapest one you hold.
Exile, -X/-X, bounce or sacrifice: cast Eerie Interlude {2}{W} with the sweeper on the stack and target every nontoken creature you want back. They return at the next end step.
With no shield in hand, sacrifice Atzocan Seer in response to return a Dinosaur card already in your graveyard to your hand.
If Vaultborn Tyrant is on the battlefield and nothing saves the board, let it die: it leaves a token copy behind.
subsequent: Count what survived: lands, Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Urza's Incubator, Mirari's Wake, Garruk's Uprising, Berserkers' Onslaught, Kessig Wolf Run. That is your mana and your next swing.
Recast Gishath before any second body. His reveal is the rebuild: about two Dinosaurs per seven damage off 28 Dinosaurs in the 99.
Rydia's Return {3}{G}{G}, mode two: return two permanent cards from your graveyard to your hand. Take Mirari's Wake if it died, otherwise the two largest Dinosaurs.
Redeploy one threat behind Gishath, not three. Hold the best Dinosaur in hand for the next sweeper.
If your board is empty and theirs is not, cast Blasphemous Act. It costs {1} less per creature on the battlefield and clears only their side (log:001).
emergency.notes: Temple Altisaur prevents all but 1 of the damage to your OTHER Dinosaurs. It takes the full damage itself, and every non-Dinosaur mana creature dies, so a damage sweeper with Altisaur out still takes the climb. Eerie Interlude returns cards, not tokens: Palani's Hatcher Eggs, the Regisaur Alpha token and Quartzwood Crasher tokens are gone.

emergency.condition_text: a spot removal spell is pointed at Gishath, or at the permanent that makes his cast or his hit
indications: A seat holds {W} or {1}{W} open after you cast Gishath: the Path to Exile and Swords to Plowshares shape.
Blue mana is open while Gishath is on the stack.
An artifact and enchantment sweep is in play at the table. On 29 October Steven's removed Mirari's Wake along with other players' artifacts and enchantments (log:003).
Removal goes at Mirari's Wake, Urza's Incubator, Berserkers' Onslaught or a reducer rather than at a body. That seat has read the deck.
immediate: Read the spell. Destroy a creature: Flawless Maneuver, Heroic Intervention, Boros Charm or Akroma's Will stops it. Destroy an artifact or enchantment: only Heroic Intervention {1}{G} or Boros Charm {R}{W}, which cover permanents. Exile or bounce: from hand, only Heroic Intervention's hexproof, Akroma's Will's protection from each colour against a coloured source, or Eerie Interlude. Devil Dinosaur on the battlefield already gives Gishath hexproof.
If the shield in hand does not match and {2}{W} is open, cast Eerie Interlude on Gishath. The removal loses its target. When he is exiled, leave him in exile; he returns at the next end step.
If the target is a reducer or Mirari's Wake and the shield costs the mana you need for Gishath, let it resolve. Shields are for Gishath and the board.

If nothing answers it, let it resolve, put Gishath in the command zone, and write down the recast: eight, plus {2} per earlier command-zone cast, less {1} for Otepec Huntmaster, {2} for Knight of the Stampede and {2} for Urza's Incubator.
subsequent: Recast Gishath with Cavern of Souls mana named Dinosaur when a blue seat is open. That spell cannot be countered.
Put Devil Dinosaur on the battlefield before the next Gishath cast. It gives your other Dinosaurs, Gishath included, hexproof against opponents.
If Mirari's Wake is gone, the replacement doubler is Regal Behemoth: one extra mana per land tapped while you are the monarch. On 29 October it carried the recast after Wake was removed (log:003).
Rydia's Return mode two returns Mirari's Wake and one more permanent card to hand.
emergency.notes: Indestructible stops neither Path to Exile nor Swords to Plowshares. Against exile, Flawless Maneuver and Boros Charm do nothing. Devil Dinosaur's hexproof covers targeting only; it does nothing against a sweeper.

emergency.condition_text: the mana is down but nothing is on the board, and Gishath is not yet castable
indications: Turn four with four mana and no play that uses it. On 29 October the board was empty until Mirari's Wake (log:003).
Turn six and Gishath is not cast. The goldfish casts him by turn six in 0.405 of games, median turn 7.
Your hand is five- and six-drops with no reducer.
Your board is mana creatures and no Dinosaur.
immediate: Count the cast: mana available against eight, plus {2} per earlier command-zone cast, less the reducers on the battlefield.
If you are short by one or two, cast a reducer before any body: Otepec Huntmaster {1}{R}, Knight of the Stampede {3}{G}, Urza's Incubator {3} named Dinosaur.
If you have five mana and three or more lands, cast Mirari's Wake. Each land tapped makes one more; on 29 October it took five mana to ten (log:003).
If you hold Natural Order and a green mana creature, sacrifice the creature for Ghalta, Primal Hunger, Vaultborn Tyrant or Carnage Tyrant. These are threats that need no command zone.
If a Dinosaur dealt combat damage to a player this turn and Hunting Velociraptor is on the battlefield, cast Dinosaurs in main two for prowl {2}{R}.
subsequent: Enlightened Tutor {W} puts Mirari's Wake, Urza's Incubator or Berserkers' Onslaught on top of your library. Cast it at the end of the opponent's turn before yours.
Keep the cheap Dinosaurs home as blockers until Gishath lands. Pugnacious Hammerskull gets a stun counter if it attacks alone.
Cast Ghalta, Primal Hunger when your total power reaches eight; it then costs {G}{G} plus two.
emergency.notes: Natural Order puts the creature onto the battlefield. Zacama's land untap reads "if you cast it", so a Natural Order Zacama does not untap your lands. Ixalli's Lorekeeper's mana pays for Dinosaur spells only: it pays for Gishath, not for Mirari's Wake or Natural Order.

emergency.condition_text: the colours have stopped: lands in play, but not the colour the hand needs
indications: Turn four with fewer than four lands.

Your hand holds double-red cards (Berserkers' Onslaught, Bonehoard Dracosaur, Quartzwood Crasher, Etali, Trumpeting Carnosaur) and you have one red source or none. Red is on curve from lands alone in 0.548 of goldfish games.
Double-green cards stranded in hand. On 15 September Selvala, Rishkar's Expertise and the GG Dinosaurs sat in hand through a long green screw (log:002).
Bloom Tender or Faeburrow Elder makes one colour only.
immediate: Cast land search before any body. Nature's Lore or Three Visits ({1}{G}) for Stomping Ground, Cinder Glade or Jetmir's Garden when red is short; Skyshroud Claim {3}{G} for two Forest cards.

Crack fetches for the missing colour. Wooded Foothills and Arid Mesa find a Mountain; Windswept Heath and Verdant Catacombs find Stomping Ground, Cinder Glade or Jetmir's Garden; Prismatic Vista finds a basic. Pay the 2 life to have Stomping Ground or Temple Garden enter untapped.
Cast a mana creature that makes any colour: Ixalli's Lorekeeper {G}, Drover of the Mighty or Intrepid Paleontologist {1}{G}, Atzocan Seer {1}{G}{W}.
If you are short of generic mana, not colour, cast a reducer instead of a body.
If a creature with power 4 or greater is on the battlefield, cast Selvala and tap her with {G} for X mana in any colours, X the greatest power you control.
subsequent: Hold creatures through a wipe-heavy table while the mana catches up. On 15 September the screw kept them out of the early wipes by accident; do it on purpose (log:002).
Cast Hulking Raptor for {G}{G} each first main phase, and Regal Behemoth to become the monarch for one extra mana per land.
Cast Itzquinth or Otepec Huntmaster before Bloom Tender or Faeburrow Elder when red is short. A red permanent on the battlefield adds red to what each of them makes.
emergency.notes: Bloom Tender and Faeburrow Elder count colours among your permanents, and lands are colourless. With only green permanents out, each makes {G} and nothing else. Ancient Ziggurat pays for creature spells only; Cavern of Souls, Unclaimed Territory and Secluded Courtyard pay colours only for Dinosaur creature spells.

emergency.condition_text: a seat will kill you before your board kills anyone, and its clock is not one your blockers stop
indications: A seat's damage comes from spells or drains, not attackers. On 15 September Oliver's vampire drain killed Sean from behind a 30-power board (log:002).
A seat's board grows every turn and you have not attacked it. On 29 October Alex's artifacts, Treasures and growing creature won the game (log:003).
Your life is under 15 and a seat is gaining what it drains.
immediate: Count the turns: their kill against yours. If theirs comes first, you attack this turn.

Remove their best attacker or engine: Path to Exile or Swords to Plowshares {W}; Itzquinth's entry for {2}, one of your Dinosaurs deals its power to it; Zacama {2}{R} for 3; Trumpeting Carnosaur's discard {2}{R} for 3; Thrashing Brontodon {1} for an artifact or enchantment.
Swing every creature at that seat. Overwhelming Stampede or Berserkers' Onslaught before combat if you hold one.
Gain life where it costs no attack: Zacama {2}{W} for 3, Tranquil Frillback's {G} for 4, Vaultborn Tyrant's 3 per power-4 entry, Akroma's Will's lifelink.
subsequent: Keep Gishath home only when he blocks the attacker that kills you. He has vigilance, so an attack costs no block.
Kinjalli's Sunwing on the battlefield makes the racing seat's new creatures enter tapped. Cast it before your next turn's swing.
emergency.notes: Blockers do nothing against a drain. Against a seat whose clock is a spell, the only defence is killing that seat first (log:002).

emergency.condition_text: somebody at the table is assembling a win that does not attack
indications: A seat stops attacking and spends its turns searching its library.
A known combo piece resolves and its controller passes with mana open.
An artifact or enchantment enters that does nothing on its own.
immediate: Name the piece you can reach. A creature: Path to Exile or Swords to Plowshares. An artifact or enchantment: Thrashing Brontodon {1} and sacrifice, or Zacama {2}{G}. A planeswalker: Boros Charm's 4 or Trumpeting Carnosaur's discard.
Spend the answer now, at instant speed, on the first piece. The deck has no counterspell, and a held answer is useless once the combo resolves.
With no answer in hand, count your swing against that seat's life. If it dies, attack it with everything this turn.
Keep Thrashing Brontodon on the battlefield with {1} untapped whenever an artifact or enchantment seat is at the table.
subsequent: Bronzebeak Foragers' entry exiles one nonland permanent from each opponent. Point it at the combo piece.
Against a graveyard combo, Tranquil Frillback exiles a graveyard on entry, and Intrepid Paleontologist exiles one card for {2}.
emergency.notes: The deck's defence against combo is a fast kill, not answers. Instant-speed interaction is the two white one-drops, Boros Charm, Carnosaur's discard and the on-board activations of Brontodon and Zacama.

keep: Two to four lands with a green source.
One mana piece castable by turn two: Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Ixalli's Lorekeeper, Bloom Tender, Drover of the Mighty, Intrepid Paleontologist, Nature's Lore, Three Visits, or a reducer.
A red source, or a fetch or Forest search that finds one.
A play on turn two and a play on turn three.
ship: Seven cards with no green source.
Five or more lands with no mana piece and no reducer.
A hand whose cheapest action is turn five.
A hand of mana creatures with no land after the first.
preflight.note: The goldfish keeps the first seven in 0.787 of games and draws ramp or fixing in 0.979. Ship to find mana, never to find a named Dinosaur: Gishath is in the command zone.

steps: Turn one: play the land that enters tapped if you hold one, then Sol Ring or Ixalli's Lorekeeper.
Name Dinosaur on Cavern of Souls, Unclaimed Territory, Secluded Courtyard, Urza's Incubator and Roaming Throne as each enters. Every time.
Turn two: a mana creature, Arcane Signet, Otepec Huntmaster, or Nature's Lore or Three Visits for a Forest card that makes red.
Turn three: Faeburrow Elder, Atzocan Seer, Urza's Incubator or Garruk's Uprising. Mana before bodies.
Attack with nothing before Gishath. Spend Path to Exile or Swords to Plowshares only on a creature that kills Gishath on sight or an engine that wins alone.
Reducers first: Otepec Huntmaster, Knight of the Stampede and Urza's Incubator lower Gishath and every Dinosaur after him. All three put Gishath at {R}{G}{W} on his first cast.
Mirari's Wake on the turn it makes Gishath castable next turn, not earlier. The table reads it as the threat (log:003); keep {1}{G} for Heroic Intervention behind it if you hold it.
Garruk's Uprising before the first reveal. It draws for each power-4 Dinosaur the reveal puts onto the battlefield and gives every creature trample.
Berserkers' Onslaught or Roaming Throne named Dinosaur on the turn before Gishath attacks. Both multiply his hit; neither is verified by a stack.
Cast Gishath on a turn he can hit a seat whose untapped blockers do not stop him, with Flawless Maneuver in hand or shield mana open. He has haste: the cast turn is the attack turn.
Set the top on the swing turn. Cast Congregation at Dawn or Worldly Tutor after your draw step and after Bonehoard Dracosaur's upkeep exile, before combat damage.
Upkeep: Bonehoard Dracosaur exiles two; play the land among them. Count Huatli's saga chapter.
Main one: land, then a reducer, then one body. Leave shield mana open.
Beginning of combat: Palani's Hatcher turns an Egg into a 3/3.
Declare attackers: Gishath, and Sunfrill Imitator as a copy of Gishath. After the first reveal, every creature that can attack.
On the connect, put Pantlaza's discover on the entering Dinosaur with the greatest toughness; it fires once a turn. Garruk's Uprising and Vaultborn Tyrant draw once per power-4 entry.
Main two: cast Dinosaurs from hand, for prowl {2}{R} if Hunting Velociraptor is out and a Dinosaur dealt combat damage.
End step: hold Flawless Maneuver, Heroic Intervention or Boros Charm through every opponent's turn.
Count every seat aloud: power against life plus untapped blockers, and Gishath's commander damage toward 21.

Add the multipliers you hold: Overwhelming Stampede {3}{G}{G}, +X/+X and trample with X your greatest power; Rydia's Return +3/+3; Berserkers' Onslaught's double strike; Kessig Wolf Run {X}{R}{G} on one attacker; Huatli's chapter IV double strike and trample.
Akroma's Will with Gishath out, cast before blockers: both modes, flying, double strike, lifelink, indestructible and protection from each colour.
Attack every seat that dies this turn (log:002).
If no seat dies, attack the seat whose board beats yours with everything (log:003).
Wait a turn only when you hold no shield and a seat has four or more mana open with a sweeper colour among it. Otherwise swing.

optics: Until Gishath, the table sees mana creatures and a few big Dinosaurs. The commander is visible in the command zone the whole game.
Mirari's Wake is a tell. On 29 October the table called it a problem the turn it landed, and an artifact and enchantment sweep took it later (log:003).
After the first reveal you are the archenemy. On 29 October every seat was dealing with Sean (log:003).
On 28 August the table spent its wipes on the mid-tier Dinosaurs and held nothing for Gishath (log:001). That is one table on one night.
reveal: Cast reducers the turn they are castable. Each turn one sits in hand is a turn of discount lost.
Hold Congregation at Dawn and Worldly Tutor for the swing turn.
Pass with no mana open when Flawless Maneuver is the shield; it costs nothing with Gishath out.
Hold Blasphemous Act until your board is smaller than theirs or empty (log:001).
alliances: Offer removal, not attacks. A Path to Exile or Swords to Plowshares on the table's shared problem buys a rotation.
No deal survives the first reveal. Your board is then the table's problem whatever you promised.
Break a deal only to kill a seat this turn, and then kill every seat the swing reaches (log:002).
Make no deal with the seat whose board you named as the danger (log:003).
targets: First connect: the seat with no untapped blocker that stops Gishath. The reveal pays the same at any life total.
After that: the seat whose board beats yours, before the seat with the lowest life (log:003).
A seat whose clock is a drain or burn spell is next, because blockers do nothing against it (log:002).
Put commander damage on one player. The seat that has taken 7 takes the next hit toward 21 (log:001, log:002).
